The '''Sun Skipper 2000 Sun Jammer''' was a model of [[sun jammer]] from [[Starshipwrights and Aerospace Engineers Incorporated]]. Its command pylon was 450 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long; its [[solar collector dish]] was 1,000 meters wide. It could carry two crew, one passenger, 300 kilograms of cargo, and one week's consumables. Its only [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] were passive. It cost 250,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new (150,000 credits used).
